description: Defines data models for recipes, ingredients, instruction steps, and an enum for difficulty levels within a recipe application.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Represents a recipe with properties such as id, title, description, image URL, cuisine, preparation and cooking times, difficulty, servings, ingredients, instructions, and favorite status. Includes a computed property totalTime.

classes.name: Ingredient
classes.description: Represents a single ingredient with a name, amount, and unit. Includes a method to display the ingredient as a formatted string.

classes.name: InstructionStep
classes.description: Represents a single instruction step with a step number and instruction text.

classes.name: Difficulty
classes.description: Enum class for recipe difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard.

methods.name: toDisplayString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string combining amount, unit, and name of the ingredient.
